style.name: Tropical Modern
style.definition: Airy teak, woven surfaces and broad-leaf greenery with architectural restraint.
style.materials: teak; cane; ivory linen; palm-green cotton; dark bronze
style.living: ivory teak-frame sofa; palm-green cane lounge chair; rectangular teak coffee table; teak cane-front TV cabinet; round teak table with four cane chairs; woven shallow pendant; large botanical artwork
style.bed: teak slatted queen; ivory bedding and palm-green throw; teak nightstands with woven-shade lamps
style.solarium: teak and rope outdoor lounge seating with palm-green performance cushions; round teak dining set; broad-leaf plants
style.implement: Let the solarium carry the lush planting while the living room stays open and ordered.
style.avoid: Avoid resort props, bamboo wall cladding or dense indoor plant walls.
